# DS-QM204-BORN-UNIQUENESS-IMPORT-BOUNDARY

Normalized p=1,2,4 weight profiles share the declared amplitude-pair domain and are recomputed exactly. Rational orthogonal rotations preserve quadratic mass while quartic mass can change. These profiles do not all satisfy Gleason/Busch effect-linearity or full physical measurement axioms. The source d2 theorem is integer arithmetic with admitted quadratic coefficients, not full Gleason uniqueness.

Supported: Exact normalized alternative profiles, quadratic rotation identity and a genuine Born/quartic divergence are kernel/native checked on the declared rational carrier.

Remaining: Supply frame-function/effect/continuity/dimension hypotheses and a uniqueness theorem. Bare normalization does not derive Born pairing.
